supporting_evidence.quote: Sir/Madam, I bought Campus Vacuum Men Lace-Up Running Shoes on the Myntra website on 22/01/2026 for Rs. 1205. I received the delivery on 27/01/2026, and I placed a return request on the same day because the shoe sole was very hard and the size was too small. At the same price, there are much better shoes available on other platforms, so I decided to return it. For that return, Myntra sent me a message saying that their delivery agent would come and collect the return order on or before 30/01/2026. However, the delivery agent did not come and wasted a lot of my time. I complained about this issue to customer care. When the delivery agent finally came today, he rejected the return, saying that there were stains on the shoes. I strongly feel that since I complained about your delivery agent, my return order is being deliberately delayed by rejecting it without any valid reason. Such behaviour is highly unprofessional. I expect this issue to be addressed immediately and the return to be processed without further delay. Additionally, I request you to kindly look into this matter, and please check the stains if any can be found in the attached photos of the shoes I received. If anything is found wrong, I will follow your advice; otherwise, you will be responsible and answerable to this issue in the consumer court.
